standard.summary: auto 会在最终保存时导出成可加载到原始底模的 LoRA
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.auto: 训练时可以特殊初始化，存盘时尽量收成能挂原底的标准 LoRA。
optionDescriptions.raw: 训练内部状态原样留着，好 resume，有的推理端吃不下。
optionDescriptions.lora_compatible: 硬收成常规 LoRA 键名。
optionDescriptions.approximate: 近似收成标准 LoRA，快一点，精度可能差一点。

standard_en.summary: auto exports, at final save time, a LoRA that can be loaded onto the original base model.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default, then short-test a few steps before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is on at the same time.

optionDescriptions.auto: Special initialisation is allowed during training, and the save is folded back into a standard LoRA that loads onto the original base wherever possible.
optionDescriptions.raw: The internal training state is kept as it is -- good for resuming, but some inference frontends will not take it.
optionDescriptions.lora_compatible: Force the save into conventional LoRA key names.
optionDescriptions.approximate: Approximate the standard LoRA form: faster, possibly less accurate.

advanced.principle: auto 会在最终保存时导出成可加载到原始底模的 LoRA；raw 保留精确训练状态用于恢复。

advanced_en.principle: auto exports a LoRA at final save that loads back onto the original base model; raw keeps the exact training state for resuming.
